name: Share Cart by DITS
author: Dits.Agency

sections.description:
Share Cart by DITS is a lightweight plugin for WooCommerce that enables users to share their shopping carts via unique links. Whether you’re a store owner looking to enhance customer experience or a shopper wanting to share your cart with friends, this plugin makes it easy. Simply click the “Share Cart” button on the WooCommerce cart page to generate a unique link. When someone opens the link, the shared cart is automatically loaded into their session.

This plugin is translation-ready.

Key features:
– Generate unique shareable links for WooCommerce carts.
– Supports both logged-in and anonymous users.
– Seamlessly integrates with the WooCommerce cart page.
– Lightweight and easy to use.

Perfect for group purchases, sharing wishlists, or collaborating on orders. Requires WooCommerce to function.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/share-cart-by-dits directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Cart and use the “Share Cart” button.
  4. Alternatively, you can use the shortcode [sharcaby_share_cart_button] to display the button on any page.
sections.faq:
How does the cart sharing work?

Users can generate a unique link for their WooCommerce cart by clicking the “Share Cart” button. The link can be shared with others, and when opened, it loads the same cart contents into the visitor’s session.

Do users need to be logged in to share a cart?

No, the plugin supports sharing carts for both logged-in and anonymous users.

What happens if a product in the shared cart is no longer available?

If a product is no longer available, the plugin will display a notice and skip adding that product to the cart.
